is_trivially_copyable alone does not promise copyability; however the supported API already requires copy construction/assignment. Supported CopyOnly remains valid because values(a) uses an lvalue copy and parameter prvalues are elided.
Nontrivial default constructors are never invoked because leaf fill copies an explicit supplied ID. Overaligned and nontrivial string elements retain alignment and lifetimes.
Nontrivially-copyable T retains std::variant branch, destructor and exception behavior.
Storage sharing, stable Node addresses, skipped owner checks, and root publication after successful update remain unchanged.
compact to final difference is one private compiler-dispatched constexpr and three condition substitutions; no public API/state/exception ordering change.

validation_harness.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess as sp,json,hashlib,os,sys,shutil
p=Path(__file__).parent
if len(sys.argv)<3:raise SystemExit('usage: run.py HEADER LABEL [quick|full]')
source=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();label=sys.argv[2];full=len(sys.argv)>3 and sys.argv[3]=='full';folder=p/label;folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2(source,folder/'header.hpp');header=folder/'header.hpp';sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest();source_hash=sha(header)
compilers={'gcc':['g++'],'clang':['clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/opt/atcoder/gcc/lib/gcc/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu/15.3.0']}
configs=[(cc,skip,False)for cc in compilers for skip in (False,True)]
if full:configs += [('clang',skip,True)for skip in (False,True)]
tests=['puf_reference_test','puf_exception_test']
if (p/'generic_layout_test.cpp').exists():tests+=['generic_layout_test']
records=[];passed=True
for test in tests:
 frozen=folder/(test+'.cpp');shutil.copy2(p/(test+'.cpp'),frozen)
 for cc,skip,san in configs:
  stem=test+'_'+cc+('_skip'if skip else '_checked')+('_san'if san else'');exe=folder/stem
  cmd=['taskset','-c','6',*compilers[cc],'-std=c++23','-O1'if san else'-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic-errors',f'-DSIRKIT_PUF_SOURCE="{header}"',str(frozen),'-o',str(exe)]
  if skip:cmd+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
  if san:cmd+=['-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer']
  r=sp.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
  record={'name':stem,'source_sha256':source_hash,'test_sha256':sha(frozen),'command':cmd,'build_returncode':r.returncode,'build_stdout':r.stdout,'build_stderr':r.stderr};records.append(record)
  if not r.returncode:
   env=dict(os.environ,ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=0')
   r=sp.run(['taskset','-c','6',str(exe)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=env)
   record.update(returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr)
  passed=record.get('returncode')==0 and not record.get('stderr')
  print(stem,'PASS'if passed else'FAIL',record.get('stdout','').strip(),record.get('stderr','')[:300],flush=True)
  (folder/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'RUNNING'if passed else'FAIL','source_sha256':source_hash,'expected_runs':len(configs)*len(tests),'results':records},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
  if not passed:break
 if not passed:break
assert sha(header)==source_hash
status='PASS'if passed and len(records)==len(configs)*len(tests)else'FAIL'
(folder/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':status,'source_sha256':source_hash,'expected_runs':len(configs)*len(tests),'results':records,'source_unchanged':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(status,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if status=='PASS'else 1)
